parsed.explanation: Trans identity is not criminalised, but visitor-facing restrictions are significant. Following the 2025 Supreme Court ruling on sex in the Equality Act, guidance supports excluding trans people from some single-sex facilities corresponding to their gender identity. Custody placement can also expose trans people to placement inconsistent with their identity; policies vary across the UK. These institutional risks matter even where everyday interactions are accepting. Anti-discrimination protections exist but do not eliminate these exclusions. The extent of enforcement and visitors’ experiences varies by setting and jurisdiction, so the score is uncertain.
